## What problem(s) does this PR solve?
Added 3 unit test cases for font variation class for issue #43440. I noticed an engineer [giving feedback](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/99687#pullrequestreview-2459665796) on #99687 so I tried to incorporate their advice, especially for testing variable font and if input values are sanitized correctly.
- The first test case is a basic test that tests if the getters and setters of the FontVariation class are working properly. (if this is not needed, I can definitely remove)
- The second test case tests if spacing was applied to `SPACING_TOP/SPACING_BOTTOM/SPACING_GLYPH`, how would that impact ascent, descent, and horizontal alignment? I downloaded a .ttf variable font Inter, from their [official website](https://rsms.me/inter/download/) and included its license (idea inspired from #112846 ). Let me know if the variable font is too large in size, I can try to reduce it.
- The third test case tests for `set_spacing` method, it should guard against incorrect spacing types that are passed as an argument
This is my first PR in godot, so let me know if I should add more test cases to certain areas or which cases to improve! I'm open to all feedback :)

## Additional information
Use of AI was used for the generating test case **ideas** and to help troubleshoot any issues that came up (for example, "what is a variable font", "summarize the terminal compiler message for me and what it means").
